summary: @servicetitan/form preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ for the detected platform, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line JS blob using rotated-string-array obfuscation (a WV8StW rotator over a large n7gIxM lookup array) with a @bun-cjs header, so it runs only under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime and is not exercised by Node-based install-time inspection. The declared purpose of the package is a form-input React library, which has no functional need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute a bundled obfuscated script during npm install. The fetch-alternate-runtime + execute-obfuscated-sibling shape delivers opaque code onto the installer's machine automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
